programs.description: Pranksters George and Harold face trouble from their principal, Mr. Krupp, for their antics. When he threatens to place them in different classes, they hypnotise him into becoming Captain Underpants.
Daniel Miller has to take care of the carpool for his sons and the neighbourhood school children when his wife falls sick. However, in the course of the day, he finds himself a victim of a robbery.
